g.text: Arthur says you owe him a drink
You seem upset. Is it something I said?
cause I told him we both think he sucks for making fun of me being an On-lyne fan ^_^
Good! He's not getting that drink.
Oh you really told him that? Hah.
Tell him he can shove it.
Tell him he owes *me* a drink for putting up with him.
I didn't love being called boring.
is this like a fun tit-for-tat thing or like an actual frustration thing?
Oh. I really didn't mean anything by it.
Well, thanks for the heads up.
So, what is the deal between the two of you?
Nah, it's fine. Just having an off day.
I just have a lot going on, but that's true for all of us.
It's all good fun, don't worry haha
take ur frustration out on the bad guys! that's what I do ;)
gosh. mean humor is so confusing
Honest. I'm sorry I upset you.
You're not boring, Aoi. I just thought I was being clever.
If you were really boring, I wouldn't be talking to you.
but u know, there really is a lot weighing on u. That might be true for all of us, but it doesn’t make ur experience any less real
It seems the jury's convinced by your defense
I just hope u know it’s okay to have off days
nah but it's cool if it's yours!
so... if the intent is to show the person you like them u tell them u don't like them?
and grants you a fresh start
Does that mean what I think it means?
Sounds like you might be speaking from experience.
Making a mental note not to joke around with you like that then.
Good, because I'm definitely going to joke around with you like that.
It only works if everyone knows each other well enough to understand where the lines are. Getting close to the line without crossing it shows you’re comfortable with each other.
ha. u ever met anyone who arrived in Höllvania emotionally stable?
u and Arthur are more alike aaall the tiiime
I appreciate your very clinical explanation of how comedy works
that is hella confusing to me
Oh, I see Aoi's emoticons are back. I think that's a good sign.
let's just say Arthur and I have been strictly professional since On-lyne's second world tour
I’ll just leave it at that
:) I like u more all the time
Is that meant to be a compliment?
I thought mean humor wasn't your style ;)
but what matters is it makes sense to you and Arthur!
You want to to tell me how Arthur screwed that up?
You're more insightful than you let on.
All right, we'll leave it at that.
I bet you say that to all the time travellers.
Arthur really does want that drink tho lol
that's a tale for another day
I hope he knows he's not getting it. ;)
And what do you want? You're saving people all the time too.
and a few too many drinks
a girl's gotta have her secrets
thx for caring about us in the hex. it doesn't go unnoticed. really.
don't let Arthur give you too much trouble, k?
Hey, you don't have to tell me anything you don't want to tell me.
I'd settle for a new stereo and world peace
I'll see what I can do.
in the wise words of Drillbit, "dream big. then hustle."
